question: Identify the plant that shows adaptation through leaves that are reduced to spines.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Opuntia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Adaptation of Opuntia**

 
 
• **Opuntia**, sometimes known as the **prickly pear cactus**, is a **xerophytic plant that grows in dry habitats and has adapted to withstand extreme conditions**.
 
• A plant species known as a **xerophyte** has evolved to **live in environments with little liquid water, such as desert or an area covered in ice or snow in the Alps or the Arctic**.
